breed.behaviour: Reuses the owned-NFT picker pattern: the wallet's owned NFTs render as tappable gen cards; tap two to pick Parent 1 + Parent 2 (a third tap is refused, tapping a picked card unpicks it). Breed checks both parents are registered + alive in the Core and that the child id is free, then sends breed on the Core (0.5 NEAR birth cost) and nft_mint for the child (0.1 NEAR deposit) from the connected wallet, reads the child back for generation + skills, and shows the child card with generation, skills, parents and both tx links. The child NFT extra records BOTH parents (parent + second_parent). Existing list/buy/delist flows are untouched.

job_board.behaviour: Reads Core get_jobs on page load (open jobs first, reward in NEAR, poster, winner). If the Core read fails, falls back to /demo/jobs-board.json and says so in the status line. Post-a-job form (brief, keywords, reward) calls post_job from the connected .testnet wallet with the reward attached as escrow; the job id is sha256(brief|keywords|timestamp) and is shown after posting; the board refreshes.
